mobbin:8914ef26-a0a5-4618-a806-8d1ccba76.summary: From an empty Templates list, the user creates a draft template in the editor, fills content, confirms Publish New Version via slide-to-publish, and returns to a library card for the new template.
steps: Publish New Version: slide to publish
Library grid with new template card
steal: Empty state: Create new or import; dual Create CTAs.
Persistent Draft badge beside title until Publish.
Publish New Version popover with ✓ No warnings + slide-to-publish.
Blank canvas offers Pick a template / Upload HTML / slash commands.
avoid: Slide-to-publish friction for routine scenario saves — keep for publish/go-live only, not every edit.
mobbin:8914ef26-a0a5-4618-a806-8d1ccba76.fit: Extends SCE with explicit draft→published versioning and pre-publish validation; maps to replacing Word/paper authoring with a basic editor, not Maestro.

mobbin:62ac5b2e-bca0-4c6c-95c5-3a11fa133.summary: In the draft editor, the user opens View History, picks a past version from the sidebar timeline, confirms Revert version (non-destructive), and gets a Version restored successfully toast while staying in Draft.
steal: Version history as a side drawer over the editor (no navigation away).
Confirm copy: creates a new version; current content preserved in history.
Relative timestamps + author avatar on each history entry.
After restore: stays Draft; Publish still required to go live.
mobbin:62ac5b2e-bca0-4c6c-95c5-3a11fa133.fit: Fills a baseline gap: SCE lacks clear version restore; non-destructive revert protects faculty authoring (contrast with checklist data loss when a window closes).
